messages:
jules: Heads-up — docs CI failed on PR #482 (migration-guide). Linkcheck + Vale + md-lint errors. Preview didn't generate. @sam can you grab the linkcheck output?

sam: on it. rerunning preview now, looks like linkcheck 404s for two external links + vale: 'PassiveVoice' on migration.md line 42.

ci-bot: Preview build failed: https://ci.redwood/invite/preview/482 — error summary: linkcheck(2), vale(1), md-lint(1). Please re-run with the helper:

```
./scripts/docs/preview --pr 482 --retry
```

jules: Thanks. I'll submit a tiny patch to fix the external links (use archive.org) and tweak wording for passive voice.

ada: I pushed a commit fixing the anchor and updated the example snippet (also formatted a code fence). PTAL @jun for a quick review — want to merge before tomorrow's release window.

jun: quick skim — looks good. One more vale complaint remains about 'we' usage. Could we rephrase to 'the system'?

ada: Updated. Also fixed md-lint bullet indentation. Ready for CI.

sam: Re-run kicked off. CI now shows linkcheck passed, md-lint passed, vale -> still 1 warning (passive voice in migration.md line 56). It's a warning not a failure, but our branch policy blocks on warnings.

jules: Are warnings blocking? I thought linkcheck and errors block but warnings not required.

docs-ops: Policy reminder: docs CI gating is set to block on vale 'error' and md-lint 'error'; however the preview pipeline treats vale warnings as errors if PR label 'strict-lint' is present. Did someone add the label?

ada: Oops I added 'strict-lint' earlier to trigger stricter checks. Removing it now.

jun: removed label. rerun pls.

ci-bot: Preview build queued. ETA ~3m.

ci-bot: Preview build passed! Preview URL: https://preview.redwood.dev/pr/482/items — ready to merge.

jules: Great. Can we merge during the 1pm UTC docs merge window? @release-coordinator

release-coordinator: 1pm UTC works. Reserve slot in merge queue.

ada: Merged at 13:02 UTC. @sam can you monitor preview for final smoke test?

sam: Looking good on staging preview. No broken links, code examples render. :thumbsup: 

jules: Thanks team. We'll add this PR to the post-release list for potential backport to v1.8 if requested.
